# Security review: PR #252, final round

Head: `cf816e679aac24e42a9e2d96d27de906bcb7fc61`

Scope: `c6a05846a4bd7f7af65ad08a7ab76d55dc53ea40..cf816e679aac24e42a9e2d96d27de906bcb7fc61`. Four changed files: composer code/tests, the new draft fixture and two documentation updates. **PASS. F252-001 is closed.** No new vulnerability or C21 disclosure found. This is the final C34 round, not a new hardening inventory.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No security vulnerabilities found | - |

## Fix disposition

`crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs:117-131` recognizes the six distinct supplied spinner frames `∙ ∘ ● ◉ ◎ ○`, followed by an ASCII space and nonblank text, at column zero. The test scans each of these frames in the captured compacting layout. Recognition is still limited to the two rows immediately preceding the composer box (`composer.rs:158-165`), and the existing early return still prevents fallback recognition.

This is explicitly a **BRAKE**: removing it can only admit the same or more frames for the same control. It does not choose a new command, change caller authority, bypass owned-input submission or replace the settled-idle state gate. An indented assistant/transcript bullet is not an activity row. A genuinely column-zero matching row in that narrow two-row window can conservatively defer, but neither recorded idle fixtures nor the three real idle observations below show a blanket idle refusal.

The new draft fixture has `┃ hello draft` on zero-based row 66 and the draft hint row `Interactive · Allow All · @ files/sessions · # issues` on row 68. That hint does not qualify as a footer, and CI confirms the fixture remains `Unrecognized` both at caret column 13 and at Home, column 2. This replaces the earlier synthetic draft whose footer did not reflect the live draft UI.

The explicitly preexisting `context`-footer plus draft-at-Home prefix-clipping behavior is unchanged by this delta. It remains a **C34 follow-up**, not an F252-001 reopen or a new merge gate. Broader dialog/sidebar hardening likewise is not a condition of this final-round verdict.

## Privacy

Read every line of the complete new 70-row `crates/harnesses/tests/fixtures/2026-11-19-copilot-v1.0.114-wide-draft.txt` and both documentation deltas. Transcript text is replaced by scrub characters; the remaining cwd is the generic scrubbed `~/work-areas/pij`, with public model/UI text, an animal seat identifier and nonsecret placeholder/usage values. No credential, private account/project/repository identity, usable private link or exposed original machine path was found. The composer borders are 250 columns and rows match the documented 250x70/caret geometry. Private originals were not accessed; same-width provenance is supplied evidence, not an independently established byte-for-byte comparison.

## Evidence

- `just pr-freeze 252`: FINAL at the full head above, clean detached worktree, latest checks green. An earlier canceled `delivers` run was superseded by a later successful run.
- `git diff --check c6a05846a4bd7f7af65ad08a7ab76d55dc53ea40..cf816e679aac24e42a9e2d96d27de906bcb7fc61`: passed.
- CI run `44447746299` has this exact head and conclusion `success`. Its successful Rust test job `135303907693` ran `cargo nextest run --locked --workspace --profile ci`: **2,529 passed, six skipped**.
- Read JUnit artifact **14494890500**, selected by ID from that successful job's upload log: **all 32 composer tests passed**, including all six activity frames, the idle fixture, the indented-bullet negative, both draft caret positions and older Copilot fixtures. Rust lint and both TS CI jobs passed.
- Read-only real-pane snapshots at **2026-11-19T03:02:04.976Z**, after the registry listed these Copilot seats as idle: `%189` was 250x70 with caret `(2,66)`, box top at row 65, preceding row 63 blank and row 64 cwd; `%188` and `%186` were 180x57 with caret `(2,53)`, box top at row 52, preceding row 50 blank and row 51 cwd. All had empty composer content and normal hints below. Thus the widened activity shape does not match these real idle layouts. Only bottom-eight-row structural summaries were emitted, withholding original paths/transcript text.
- No local build, test, mutation execution, pane input, compaction command or daemon bounce. Live observations prove current layout, not execution of the unmerged classifier or post-merge compact delivery. Supplied spinner-table/live-compaction provenance and mutation results were not independently rerun.

No new scheduling loop, poll, timer, process launch or per-seat launch multiplier. The delta replaces one nearby-row predicate with a six-character membership check and a text-shape check.

Harness lesson: activity animation must be reviewed as its complete frame vocabulary and layout shape, not one captured glyph. Evidence-bearing clean review reports remain the harness improvement request recorded in the previous role memory.
